findings.title: Two absolute syntax claims in the module document are false for some inputs at the pinned commit

serves.scenario: A fresh claim checker reading the Tokenizing and Parsing claims against 712fcfd finds two absolute statements that the cited code contradicts, so the criterion 'no unsupported claim' fails. (1) The document says a tag keyword 'must be one of the 22 listed names ... or a SyntaxError "Unknown template tag" is thrown' and that 'a plain {{name}} without $ reaches this error'. But getTokenType does `mapping[keyword] || null` on a plain object literal, and extractKeyword returns the whole content when there is no leading [A-Z_] run. So {{constructor}}, {{toString}} or {{hasOwnProperty}} get an inherited Object.prototype member as the token type, skip the unknown-tag error, and fail later in the parser with 'Unexpected token: function ...'. (2) The document says a top-level ROW that is 'not closed ... raises "Unclosed {{ROW}} block"'. But parseTableRow also breaks, without error, on a following ROW or END_TABLE token, so {{ROW}}a{{ROW}}b{{END_ROW}} leaves the first ROW unclosed and does not raise.

findings.rubric: c2 / ar-02: a fresh claim checker reads every claim against the pinned commit and finds no unsupported claim (also rubric: each criterion is met by the diff and its test)
findings.reproduction: 1. git -C C:/n8n-run show 712fcfd:nodes/TemplateResolver/lexer.ts and read lines 359-362 (extractKeyword returns the whole content when there is no uppercase match) and 367-394 (`return mapping[keyword] || null` on an object literal). With the template '{{constructor}}', keyword = 'constructor', mapping['constructor'] === Object (truthy), so tokenType !== null and the error at lines 237-244 is not thrown. parser.ts:83-89 then throws 'Unexpected token: function Object() ...' instead. 2. git show 712fcfd:nodes/TemplateResolver/parser.ts, lines 773-790: the while loop breaks on check(ROW) or check(END_TABLE) before the isAtEnd check, so a ROW followed by another ROW returns a node without END_ROW and without the 'Unclosed {{ROW}} block' error. Smallest fix: qualify the two sentences in docs/living/architecture/modules/template-resolver.md, for example 'unless the content matches an inherited Object.prototype member name, which instead fails in the parser with "Unexpected token"' and 'when the file ends before END_ROW', citing lexer.ts:359-394, parser.ts:83-89 and parser.ts:778-787. Or move the edge cases to an open question.
